    • getPerformantaMedie

      public double getPerformantaMedie(Duck.TipRata tip)
      Returns the average performance of all ducks in a Card. Performance is calculated as the average of each duck's speed (viteza) and endurance (rezistenta), then averaged across all ducks in the card.
      Parameters:
      tip - Duck.TipRata type (SWIMMING or FLYING)
      Returns:
      the average performance, or 0.0 if no ducks exist in the card
